df_cutin.design: Native CutinEnv (CutinEnv): two lanes, ego starts in the empty lane at x=200 at 6.94 m/s; the target lane is populated by the environment's own 43-48 Cautious/Normal/Aggressive vehicles with independent random labels and 5-20 m spacing at 6.94 m/s. The adapter requires a cut-in to lane 0, opens the decision at x=230, sets a 350 m route goal and a 6.94 m/s speed limit, and removes only the target-lane vehicles within 40 m of the ego's initial x to create a feasible local merge window. Remaining traffic keeps its native random type labels and native behaviour; no scripted yield/force response is added. All variants use the same scene, controller, reward, candidate set, prompt v5 and LLM settings.
